name: Tensei Shitenai Akuyaku Reijou wa Mada Unmei o Shiranai
original_name: 転生してない悪役令嬢はまだ運命を知らない
source:
What will come to her who reincarnated as a villainess? Whether she will fail or succeed? You decide her destiny!

[from [url=https://klast-halc.itch.io/villainess-fate]itch.io[/url]]
